routes.claim: The exact v4.6 parent leaves five synthetic recognized credential forms unchanged.
routes.passCondition: All five cases are unchanged through the diagnostic-redaction module loaded from the parent Git blob.
routes.counterevidence: Any baseline case changes or contains the explicit marker.
routes.secondarySurface: Parent tools-index truth lacks the recognized-credential declaration.
routes.observedEvidence: Five of five baseline cases are unchanged and the qualified truth flag is absent.
routes.namedSeam: Synthetic evidence proves the bounded gap, not an observed live credential leak.

routes.claim: Recognized credential evidence is replaced before persistence.
routes.passCondition: Direct fixtures, product Git-blob probes, readiness ingestion, and clean replay all remove fixture values and retain the marker.
routes.counterevidence: A supported fixture value remains or the marker is missing.
routes.observedEvidence: All direct, Git-blob, and clean-ingestion checks pass.
routes.namedSeam: Novel, encoded, split, or semantically inferred secrets are not covered.

routes.claim: Useful non-credential diagnostic context remains available.
routes.passCondition: Relative paths, URI host/path context, non-credential query/CLI values, and ordinary token/secret prose remain asserted.
routes.counterevidence: Ordinary context disappears or is rewritten as a credential marker.
routes.secondarySurface: Current tools-index tail projection remains exact.
routes.observedEvidence: Direct preservation assertions pass and all twelve existing tails are unchanged.
routes.namedSeam: Some conservative false-positive redaction remains possible.

routes.claim: Redaction does not mutate the source receipt or replace its raw-output digest.
routes.passCondition: Source object bytes remain equal and outputSha256 passes through exactly in direct and clean-ingestion checks.
routes.counterevidence: Input receipt changes or outputSha256 differs.
routes.observedEvidence: Both surfaces record immutability and exact digest continuity.
routes.namedSeam: The hash proves raw-output identity, not that raw output is safe to retain elsewhere.

routes.claim: Every production readiness failureTail writer and readiness ingestion route uses the shared sanitizer.
routes.passCondition: Repository search finds only the generator and daily writer, both call failureTail, and tool-readiness sanitizes supplied results.
routes.counterevidence: An unredacted production failureTail assignment exists.
routes.observedEvidence: The two writers reuse the sanitizer and ingestion independently re-sanitizes.
routes.namedSeam: Other diagnostic field names are outside this route.

routes.claim: The current tools-index failure tails contain no evidence recognized by the product redactor.
routes.passCondition: All twelve retained tails are idempotent under the product redactor and the qualified truth flag is true.
routes.counterevidence: Any tail changes on re-sanitization or the truth flag is absent.
routes.observedEvidence: Both surfaces pass across twelve tails.
routes.namedSeam: Idempotence cannot prove absence of unrecognized secrets.

routes.claim: The product satisfies the repository's required scripted checks.
routes.passCondition: All ten AGENTS.md commands exit zero against the product state.
routes.secondarySurface: Clean archived product replay for the changed seam.
routes.observedEvidence: Ten of ten required commands pass.
routes.namedSeam: Script success is not browser usability, human review, or CANON.

routes.claim: The committed product slice replays without relying on dirty workspace state.
routes.passCondition: An exact Git archive passes five checks and synthetic ingestion while all tracked slice files remain unchanged.
routes.counterevidence: Archive identity mismatch, a command failure, ingestion failure, or changed tracked file.
routes.secondarySurface: Product commit and tree identity in SOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json.
routes.observedEvidence: Five of five commands and ingestion pass across fifteen unchanged files.
routes.namedSeam: This is an isolated product slice, not a full clean-repository replay.

routes.claim: The operations aggregate non-pass is foreign to v4.7 and remains visible.
routes.passCondition: Recovery tests pass first; failure occurs at the missing curated intake; service and npm script are exact across baseline/product; intake is absent in all three states.
routes.counterevidence: Changed failing source, a v4.7 stack path, present intake, or earlier regression.
routes.observedEvidence: The result is classified FOREIGN_FAILURE with CURATED_VERIFICATION_INTAKE_MISSING.

routes.claim: The seam grants no promotion, merge, CANON, human, or provider authority.
routes.passCondition: Only diagnostic source, tests, truth metadata, and a derived index change; no authority route is added; Mike Tobi / AXM remains gate.
routes.counterevidence: An execution, promotion, merge, provider, identity, or CANON route appears.
routes.secondarySurface: Human governance decision remains externally required.
routes.namedSeam: Only Mike Tobi / AXM can supply the human merge or CANON decision.
